profile_text.body:
Tabnine is a software company headquartered in Middletown, Delaware that develops an AI code assistant aimed at enterprise software teams. The company describes its product as accelerating and simplifying software development while keeping code private, secure, and compliant. Its platform centers on what it calls an Enterprise Context Engine, which it says learns an organization's architecture, frameworks, and coding standards rather than relying on generic training data, and is designed to work across mixed stacks, legacy systems, multiple models, IDEs, and deployment environments including cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped installations.

The core product, also called Tabnine, is categorized as a coding and developer tool offering code completion with a self-host option. The company describes the platform as providing a context layer that can be made available to any agent or tool across a developer's preferred environment. Tabnine has described itself as a Visionary in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Code, according to its own site.

The held facts show Tabnine is incorporated in Delaware with eleven associated legal exposure records in that state, though no specific litigation cases are on file. The company has a verified profile on theworldofai.org as of August 2026 and does not currently have a listed MCP server presence.
